question: In a population 60% of the inhabitants are men. The random variable "number of men in a group of 10 people" follows a distribution of type:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Binomial distribution" -> "used to model the number of successes in a fixed number of trials" -> "applicable when each trial is independent and has the same probability of success" -> 80%
analysis: The random variable 'number of men in a group of 10 people' follows a binomial distribution since it involves a fixed number of trials (10 people) with each trial having two possible outcomes (man or not a man) and the probability of success (being a man) remains constant at 60% for each trial.
